tools.description: Search up to five live contract technology jobs, without an account. Use taxonomy IDs for roles and 1099/c2c/w2_contract for engagement. title_contains matches titles (including stack terms), not full descriptions. Rates require an explicit currency and are hourly. Exact is the default. Closest may relax ONLY the title if zero exact results and a role taxonomy filter is supplied; rate, location, contract, and freshness constraints remain. Without a role/title, search is limited to 2,000 recently discovered technology jobs. No pagination, bulk export, permanent-only searches, or processing jobs.
